InstituteProfile.Name: Avijan
InstituteProfile.Tagline: Nurturing talent through disciplined practice since day one.
InstituteProfile.Introduction: Avijan is a music and fine-arts institute offering structured, examination-oriented training in classical and contemporary disciplines. Every student follows an individually paced syllabus under a dedicated faculty member, with progress recorded, assessed and reported through the institute's own management system.
Highlights: One-to-one and small-group instruction across five disciplines
Faculty drawn from performing musicians and practising artists
Transparent monthly fee ledger with printable receipts
Term examinations with recorded marks and issued certificates
Annual function giving every student a stage performance
